idea-plugin.name: Living Code
idea-plugin.description:
Living Code theme for JetBrains IDEs. Calm slate. Living color. Dark and light interface themes with matching editor color schemes.

It is built on a perceptually uniform OKLCH palette, so every syntax color keeps the same weight and every flavor keeps WCAG AA contrast. It works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider, CLion, RubyMine, PhpStorm, DataGrip and Android Studio.

Four themes are included:

  • Living Code Night: The default. Dark slate ground, teal structure, green strings and gray comments. Amber warnings and copper numbers keep their warm contrast.
  • Living Code Frost: Night on a lifted, bluer slate with a third less chroma. Calmer for long sessions; the warm/cool split survives at low saturation.
  • Living Code Paper: Daylight. Same two temperatures on near-white slate, lightness inverted so every syntax color keeps WCAG AA contrast.
  • Living Code Signal: A minimal variant of Night with a single accent. Teal marks keywords, tags and focus; everything else stays on the slate ramp. No warm literals or multicolor diagnostics.

After installing, pick a theme in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Theme. The matching editor color scheme is applied together with it.

Source and issues: https://github.com/living-code-theme/jetbrains
